prompt: Some people believe schools should focus on practical life skills rather than academic subjects. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay: Schools should teach practical skills because students need to manage everyday tasks. For example, learning to budget helps young adults make better decisions. However, academic subjects also matter because they help students think critically. Both types of learning should have a place in school.
